```{r}
library("tidyr", "ggplot2")
pacman::p_load(ggplot2 , tidyr)
# example
con_tbl <- tbl(con, "visits_core")# %>% 
  #select(age, visit_id, starts_with("Ddx"))

con_tbl
```

```{r}
pacman::p_load(gtsummary)
con_shortened <- con_tbl %>% 
   pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Ddx"),
    names_to = "diagnosis_type",
    values_to = "diagnosis_1"
  ) %>%
   filter(!is.na(diagnosis)) %>%
collect()
con_shortened
```

```{r}
con_shortened %>% 
  group_by(diagnosis_type) %>% 
  summarise(n = n())

```


```{r}
con_demo <- tbl(con, "visits_core") %>% 
  select(visit_id, starts_with("bigchris")) %>%
   pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("bigchris"),
    names_to = "demographics",
    values_to = "results") %>%
  filter(!is.na(results)) %>% 
collect()

con_demo
```

```{r}
ggplot(con_shortened, aes(x = diagnosis , fill = diagnosis)) +
  geom_bar() +
  facet_wrap(~ diagnosis_type)
```

```{r}

ggplot(con_shortened, aes(x = age, fill = diagnosis )) +
  geom_bar() +
  facet_wrap(~ diagnosis_type)
```

```{r}
ggplot(con_shortened, aes(x = diagnosis, y = age, fill = diagnosis)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ diagnosis_type)
  
```

# variables are all written differently

```{r}
demographics_tbl <- tbl(con, "visits_core") %>% 
  select(ptid, visit_id, csa_id, race, eth, age, gender, visit_type, visit_date) %>%
  collect 
```
```{r}
colSums(is.na(demographics_tbl))
```


```{r}
library(stringr)

shape <- demographics_tbl$visit_id %>%
  str_replace_all("[0-9]", "9") %>%
  str_replace_all("[A-Za-z]", "A")



basic <- data.frame(demographics_tbl$visit_id, shape)

```

```{r}
table(basic$shape)
```

```{r}
#even more simple 

shape_1 <- demographics_tbl$visit_id %>%
  str_replace_all("[[:alnum:]]", "9") 



basic_1 <- data.frame(demographics_tbl$visit_id, shape_1)
basic_1$ptid <- demographics_tbl$ptid
basic_1$csa <- demographics_tbl$csa_id
table(basic_1$shape_1)
```

```{r}
basic_1 %>% filter(shape_1 == "9999999999-9999999999999") %>% unique
```


#attempt at making new id val

```{r} 
basic_1$new_id<- str_remove(basic_1$demographics_tbl.visit_id, "-.*")
#frequncy table code
basic_1 %>% group_by(new_id) %>% summarize(n = n()) %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(n) %>% summarise(count = n())
#histogram
basic_1 %>% group_by(new_id) %>% summarize(n = n()) %>% ggplot(aes(x= n))+
  geom_histogram()
```
